# Brokermogger

> Free, open source privacy request desk. People prepare, approve, send and track privacy requests to data brokers. Nothing leaves an instance without an approved snapshot. It is not a law firm and it does not guarantee removal.

## Site

- [Home](/): product description, limitations, security principles, self-hosting
- [Sign in](/login): magic-link authentication (private)
- [security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt): vulnerability contact

Authenticated routes (`/dashboard`, `/vault`, `/requests`, `/admin`, and others) hold personal data and must not be crawled.

## Project

- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
- Source: https://github.com/ArturLauche/brokermogger
- No billing, scraping, CAPTCHA bypass or guaranteed removal
